tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one published Wildmart product by ID for comparison or details. Returns identifiers, price/availability when fresh, canonical URL, image, categories, attributes, filters and variants. Omits long descriptions and image galleries; unpublished products are unavailable.

language.description: Storefront language; defaults to the current URL, otherwise Russian.

tools.name: get_store_information
tools.description: Get public Wildmart identity, currency, country and localized website and policy links. Use for delivery, returns or store policy discovery. Returns links, not full policy text or customer information.

language.description: Storefront language; defaults to the current URL, otherwise Russian.

tools.name: inspect_image_c2pa
tools.description: Fetch a single image (by CSS selector or URL) and return its fully decoded C2PA manifest store: every manifest's claim, assertions (e.g. c2pa.actions edit history, schema.org authorship), and the COSE signature details (algorithm and signing-certificate identity). Provide exactly one of `selector` or `url`. Note: the signature is decoded but NOT cryptographically verified.

selector.description: CSS selector for an element on the page.

url.description: Image URL (absolute, or relative to the current page) to fetch and inspect.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: Browse a page of brands represented by published Wildmart products to obtain IDs for search_products. Returns brand names, URLs, freshness and next cursor; not the entire brand directory.

language.description: Storefront language; defaults to the current URL, otherwise Russian.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the preceding call. Keep language and filters unchanged.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Browse a page of published Wildmart categories to obtain IDs for search_products. Returns localized names, category URLs and parent IDs with freshness and next cursor; not the entire category tree.

language.description: Storefront language; defaults to the current URL, otherwise Russian.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the preceding call. Keep language and filters unchanged.

tools.name: scan_images_c2pa
tools.description: Scan every on the current page for C2PA Content Credentials (content provenance metadata) and return a per-image summary: whether a manifest is present, the claim generator (the tool that produced or edited the image), the title, and the signer name. Use this to find which images on a page carry provenance data. Note: provenance is decoded but NOT cryptographically verified.

limit.description: Maximum number of images to fetch and scan (default 25, max 100).

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find or compare published Wildmart products by name, model, brand or code. Omit query to browse; optional category/brand IDs filter results. Returns compact products, canonical URLs, freshness and a next cursor; stale price/availability remain suppressed. Keep filters unchanged when paging.

language.description: Storefront language; defaults to the current URL, otherwise Russian.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the preceding call. Keep language and filters unchanged.

query.description: Product name, model, brand, SKU or search phrase supported by the public API.
